claim: The pd-sidecar's SSRF-protection allowlist has no non-Kubernetes source: it is populated exclusively by watching one named InferencePool CRD and the pods matched by that pool's label selector.
stance_target: gap-3: SSRF protection is InferencePool/Kubernetes-coupled with no static/CIDR alternative
scope_conditions: llm-d-router@main, pkg/sidecar/proxy/allowlist.go, current HEAD as of 2026-09-11
quoted_support: // AllowlistValidator manages allowed prefill targets based on InferencePool resources ... loadingRules := clientcmd.NewDefaultClientConfigLoadingRules() ... failed to get Kubernetes config (ensure running in a pod with proper RBAC)

claim: When SSRF protection is disabled, IsAllowed() unconditionally returns true for every host:port, explicitly documented as 'backward compatibility'.
stance_target: gap-3: without Kubernetes, the sidecar accepts arbitrary hosts

claim: The allowlist only ever contains a matched pod's IP address and pod name -- no support for arbitrary hostnames, CIDR ranges, or external service endpoints even when enabled.
stance_target: gap-3: allowlist mechanism is pod-identity-based, not network-based
quoted_support: podIP, _, _ := unstructured.NestedString(pod.Object, "status", "podIP") ... if podIP != "" { av.allowedTargets.Insert(podIP) } ... if podName != "" { av.allowedTargets.Insert(podName) }
